label: Flat Front (No Dart)
description: A flat front has no pleats or darts at all, so the cloth runs smooth and uninterrupted from the waistband down the front. It gives the cleanest, most modern and slimming silhouette and pairs naturally with a plain hem. It works best on slimmer cuts where there is no excess fabric to manage.
